how: uv run python tools/mutants.py docs/quantities/qt-a3c/mutants.json --no-baseline --evidence docs/quantities/qt-a3c/evidence/mutants-run.json, after a passing build. Each mutant is applied alone, its command rebuilds the module whose #guard, proof or test must fail (the dispatch mutant first replaces runMode_cardinality's rfl by sorry, so its kill is the service test's), and the harness restores the file's exact bytes.

mutants.claim: the cardinality@0 row requires W6a's three profiles
command: cd lean && PATH=$HOME/.elan/bin:$PATH lake build VE.Compose.Examples

mutants.claim: cardinalityOthers: the row refuses every other profile
command: cd lean && PATH=$HOME/.elan/bin:$PATH lake build VE.Compose.Examples

mutants.claim: modeProfiles: Python's environment list leaves cardinality@0 out
command: cd lean && PATH=$HOME/.elan/bin:$PATH lake build VE.Compose.Examples

mutants.claim: Mode.name: the mode is named cardinality
command: cd lean && PATH=$HOME/.elan/bin:$PATH lake build ResponseShape.Skeletons
mutants.test: ResponseShape/Skeletons.lean every mode's row is its file's

mutants.claim: runMode: the mode runs the cardinality runner
command: cd lean && python3 -c "import pathlib; p = pathlib.Path('VE/Service/Protocol.lean'); s = p.read_text(); p.write_text(s.replace('runMode .cardinality j = VE.Cardinality.Run.runCaseReported j := rfl', 'runMode .cardinality j = VE.Cardinality.Run.runCaseReported j := sorry'))" && cd .. && uv run pytest -q -x tests/test_cardinality_service.py
mutants.test: ResponseShape.Encoders.runMode_fits (the mode's row fits cardinality.json only through the cardinality runner): the service test's ve_service build fails there

mutants.claim: runCaseReported_fits: a statement row has its meaning id and formula
command: cd lean && PATH=$HOME/.elan/bin:$PATH lake build ResponseShape.Encoders.Cardinality

mutants.claim: cardinality_rows: a certificate row only for the kind certificate
command: cd lean && PATH=$HOME/.elan/bin:$PATH lake build ResponseShape.Encoders.Cardinality

mutants.claim: chargedNodes: the build stops once the total passes the limit
mutants.find: if used > VE.Limits.maxNodes then used else used +
command: cd lean && PATH=$HOME/.elan/bin:$PATH lake build VE.Cardinality.RunExamples

mutants.find: (countedUniversals E (c :: ps)).map (fun x _ => bridge E (c :: ps) x) ++
command: cd lean && PATH=$HOME/.elan/bin:$PATH lake build VE.Cardinality.RunTheorems

mutants.claim: problemChecks: P3's refusal is W6a's aggregate text
command: cd lean && PATH=$HOME/.elan/bin:$PATH lake build VE.Cardinality.RunExamples

mutants.claim: DEADLINES: the mode has its CPU deadline
